premises.text: Crowd connectivity can connect IoT more efficiently and cost-effectively if participants are rewarded and connections are secure
premises.evidence_span: we could leverage cloud connectivity to connect more efficiently, more cost effectively, the next trillion things to the internet. And we could do that if we could first make sure that everyone participating in the network would be rewarded. And second, if we could make sure that every connection is safe and secure

premises.text: Participants earn nodal cash for the data they move on the network
premises.evidence_span: the more data you move, the more value there is in the data you move, the more you earn nodal cash or cryptocurrency

premises.text: Smartphones with the app become IoT gateways that relay sensor data to the cloud
premises.evidence_span: these smartphones become IoT gateway or access points for IoT

premises.text: Rendezvous is a blockchain-based communication protocol that verifies device identity and can revoke compromised devices
premises.evidence_span: we created a communication protocol that has security built in. It's called Rendezvous

premises.text: The solution is 100% software for enterprises and smart cities for asset tracking and sensor collection
Phone OEM and enterprise router partnerships distribute the software at scale
premises.evidence_span: we partnered with amazing companies like HTC, who basically pre-installed our app on their smartphones. We partnered with Cisco Meraki, who is pushing our software for their routers for their enterprise customers

value.text: Connect the next trillion things to the internet more efficiently, cost-effectively, and securely
value.evidence_span: connect more efficiently, more cost effectively, the next trillion things to the internet

secondary_value.text: People reclaim ownership and earn rewards for helping build a more secure private IoT internet
secondary_value.evidence_span: be rewarded and earn Nodal Cash each time you help smart cities, companies, and businesses build a more secure and private internet for connecting their things

causal_links.evidence_span: everyone participating in the network would be rewarded
smartphones become IoT gateway or access points for IoT
every connection is safe and secure
pre-installed our app on their smartphones

notes: FireChat bio and install/device counts excluded as credentials/traction per §4.2. Rendezvous certificate, trustless, and revoke details folded into one security premise (§4.1(5)). Citizen Network / reclaim ownership framing treated as vision (§4.1(4)); recorded partly in secondary_value. Singleton D3/D4: security protocol and partner distribution separately revisable from the reward model.
